games.title: Casino
games.subtitle: Classic Dominican Casino Game
games.description: Capture cards from the table that match the value of the card you play. Special cards earn extra points. First player to reach the target score wins the game.
rules: Reach the target score to win

games.title: Tres y Dos
games.subtitle: Form a 3 and a 2 of matching ranks
games.description: Form a set of 3 and a set of 2 of the same card ranks before the other players do. First player to claim the sets wins!

games.title: Robaito
games.subtitle: Steal stacks and dominate the table
games.description: Capture cards from the table and steal from other players' stacks. The player with the most cards at the end wins!
